description: Removes a job posted by the signed-in user. close, withdraw, and delete are the same removal the website Delete button performs, including a job still in pending_review: the job document is removed, the public listing is removed, and an audit snapshot is kept. Does not charge or refund anyone. Does nothing unless confirm=true. jobId is the id from list_my_jobs.
name: close_job
title: Close a job you posted
